meta.title: 8个妙招，快速改善拍照“显胖”问题
meta.title_en: 8 Tricks to Fix Looking Fat in Photos

scenes.title_cn: 开场：上镜显胖一直是我们日常拍照最常…
scenes.title_en: Opening: looking fat on camera is the most…
scenes.context: 拍摄时的自然显瘦诉求。
sentences: 上镜显胖一直是日常拍照最常见的问题。
Looking fat on camera is the most common photo complaint.
look fat on camera（上镜显胖）
除了后期大力出奇迹，拍的时候又该如何调整？
Beyond heroic post-editing, how to adjust while shooting?
shoot-time adjust（拍摄时调整）
paraphrase: look fat on camera（上镜显胖
look fat on camera（上镜显胖
scenes.speak: Looking fat on camera is the most common photo complaint. Beyond heroic post-editing, how to adjust while shooting?

scenes.title_cn: 技巧一·不做挤压动作：除非你非常苗条…
scenes.title_en: Trick one · no squeezing: unless you're ve…
sentences: 不要去做任何挤压肢体的动作，会大大加剧肉感。
Avoid limb-squeezing poses—they amp up fleshiness.
squeezing poses（挤压动作）
手臂尽量离开一点身体，给出一点空间，会瞬间轻盈不少。
Keep arms slightly off the body for air; instantly lighter.
arm gap（手臂留空）
scenes.speak: Avoid limb-squeezing poses—they amp up fleshiness. Keep arms slightly off the body for air; instantly lighter.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧二·背部打开：总感觉拍出来的照片…
scenes.title_en: Trick two · open the back: photos always l…
sentences: 总感觉照片背很厚、肩很圆、人很笨重。
Photos always look thick-backed, round-shouldered, heavy.
thick back（背厚）
背部向后打开，然后向下回落定住。
Open the back backward, then settle down and hold.
open the back（背部打开）
真有体态问题，还是需要科学改善。
Real posture issues still need scientific fixing.
posture issues（体态问题）
scenes.speak: Photos always look thick-backed, round-shouldered, heavy. Open the back backward, then settle down and hold. Real posture issues still need scientific fixing.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧三·提颈收下巴：脖子肥大或双下巴…
scenes.title_en: Trick three · lift the neck: for a thick n…
sentences: 脖子肥大或是双下巴问题，可以用一个动作改善。
A thick neck or double chin can be fixed with one move.
double chin（双下巴）
先用力向上提起脖子，然后向前探出一点，再回落。
Lift the neck up hard, ease forward, then settle back.
lift the neck（提脖子）
颈部视觉是改善上镜显胖问题的绝对核心。
The neck line is the absolute core of the fix.
neck line is core（颈部为核心）
scenes.speak: A thick neck or double chin can be fixed with one move. Lift the neck up hard, ease forward, then settle back. The neck line is the absolute core of the fix.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧四·模糊比例：拍照无论在穿搭还是…
scenes.title_en: Trick four · blur the proportions: in both…
sentences: 在穿搭和构图上，一定要学会模糊比例。
In outfits and composition, learn to blur the ratio.
blur the ratio（模糊比例）
有了明确腰线就会暴露并不理想的身材比例。
A clear waistline exposes an unflattering ratio.
clear waistline（明确腰线）
构图上直接拍半身，不会显高，但的确会显瘦。
Shoot half-body—not taller, but certainly slimmer.
half-body shot（拍半身）
scenes.speak: In outfits and composition, learn to blur the ratio. A clear waistline exposes an unflattering ratio. Shoot half-body—not taller, but certainly slimmer.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧五·露脖子+技巧六·用侧光：上半…
scenes.title_en: Trick five · bare the neck + trick six · s…
scenes.context: 露脖子减厚重、侧光造阴影。
sentences: 肩膀到脖子区域要避开太多元素，把脖子干干净净地露出来。
Clear the shoulder-to-neck area; bare the neck completely.
bare the neck（露脖子）
完全顺着光拍会把人拍得很扁平，要学会使用侧光。
Frontal light flattens you; learn side light.
side light（侧光）
脸上的阴影和四肢的阴影，也是显瘦的关键。
Face and limb shadows are key to slimming.
shadows slim（阴影显瘦）
scenes.speak: Clear the shoulder-to-neck area; bare the neck completely. Frontal light flattens you; learn side light. Face and limb shadows are key to slimming.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧七·90度调整法+技巧八·向下调…
scenes.title_en: Trick seven · the 90-degree rule + trick e…
sentences: 正脸就完全正，侧脸就完全侧，身体也是一样。
Full front or full side—body too.
90-degree rule（90度调整法）
让下巴和下颚面往上走会弱化阴影，往下走会强化阴影。
Lifting the chin weakens shadows; dropping strengthens them.
weaken shadows（弱化阴影）
只要别挤压脖子，肯定会显瘦一些。
As long as you don't crush the neck, it slims.
don't crush the neck（别挤压脖子）
scenes.speak: Full front or full side—body too. Lifting the chin weakens shadows; dropping strengthens them. As long as you don't crush the neck, it slims.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：以上就是缓解拍照显胖问题的八个…
scenes.title_en: Wrap-up: those are the eight practical tri…
sentences: 以上就是缓解拍照显胖问题的八个实用技巧。
Those are the eight practical tricks for looking slim in photos.
eight tricks（八个技巧）
想要学习更系统的人像摄影知识，可以去课程栏目了解。
For more systematic portrait photography, check the course section.
course section（课程栏目）
让所有普通人都能拍出好看照片的摄影师小李。
I'm Li, helping everyone shoot great photos.
photographer Li（摄影师小李）
scenes.speak: Those are the eight practical tricks for looking slim in photos. For more systematic portrait photography, check the course section. I'm Li, helping everyone shoot great photos.

practice: Keep arms off the body, never squeeze limbs.
Open the back backward, settle, and hold.
Lift the neck, ease forward, and settle back.
Blur the waistline with clothes or half-body shots.
Use side light in the soft late afternoon.
Full front or full side as the last resort.
pitfalls: Keep arms off the body for space.
Accept a thick back and round shoulders.
Open the back backward and hold.
背部打开回落，优化上镜状态。
Lift the neck to reduce the double chin.
Reveal the waistline in full body.
Blur the ratio with outfits or half-body framing.
Learn side light with soft low sun.
真有体态问题要科学改善。
shifts: 用 fleshiness（肉感）、blur the ratio（模糊比例）、side light（侧光）
用 open the back（背部打开）、lift the neck（提脖子）、90-degree rule（90度调整法）
用 on-camera presence（上镜状态）、half-body shot（半身）、weakens shadows（弱化阴影）
